email_address.description: The sending email address to use. Uses the account's sending email address if not provided.

email_template_id.description: Id of the email template to use.

send_days.description: The days of the week to send the sequence on. Must be one of: `monday`, `tuesday`, `wednesday`, `thursday`, `friday`, `saturday`, `sunday`.

send_hour.description: The hour of the day to send the sequence at. Must be an integer between 0 and 23.

time_zone.description: The timezone to use for the sequence. Must be a valid IANA timezone string.

active.description: `true` to activate the sequence, `false` to deactivate it.

repeat.description: When `true`, subscribers can restart the sequence multiple times.

hold.description: When `true`, subscribers added via Visual Automations stay in the sequence after receiving the last email.

exclude_subscriber_sources.description: The subscriber sources to exclude from the sequence.

type.description: The type of subscriber source to exclude. Must be one of: `tag`, `sequence`, `form`, `segment`.

items.description: The ids of the subscriber sources to exclude.
